# WaterWave

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("WaterWave")`

One wave of the `Water` it is in (ADR 0118): the first eight, in order, make the surface. It travels at the speed deep water gives its length.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Amplitude` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | Metres a crest rises above the still surface. |
| `Direction` | `number` | `0` | read/write | Which way it travels, in degrees about the vertical: 0 along +X, 90 along +Z. |
| `Phase` | `number` | `0` | read/write | Where in its cycle it starts, in radians, so two alike waves need not rise together. |
| `Steepness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | 0 a rounded swell, 1 sharp crests and flat troughs. |
| `Wavelength` | `number` | `40` | read/write | Metres from one crest to the next. |
